builtFrom: Built from the official trophy descriptions only. The game was a day old when this guide was written, so where a place or step is not pinned down by the description, the guide says so instead of guessing.
missableRule: A trophy is flagged MISSABLE when its official description ties it to one named mission, one character's final mission, or one specific event that may not come back — the opening mission, the finale, a partner-only job, or a single attempt. Chapter trophies are never flagged: finishing a chapter cannot be missed. Flags are our reading of the official descriptions, not yet checked in-game; check mission replay before assuming a trophy is lost.

stages.name: Play the story — Chapters 1 to 4
stages.order: Do this first, in story order. Never skip a named mission: every mission trophy below only comes around when the story offers that mission.
stages.warning: MISSABLE — 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 are single-mission trophies. Take each mission the first time it appears and save before you start it.

stages.name: Character strands and strangers
stages.order: While the story runs, answer every stranger and finish each character's missions as they appear — do not stockpile them for later.
stages.warning: MISSABLE — 22, 23, 24, 26, 27 are each a character's FINAL mission. Clear a character's earlier missions before their finale, and save first.

stages.name: The finale, then 100%
stages.order: Before the final mission, sweep the missable lane on this board one last time. Then finish the story and chase the completion percentage.
stages.warning: MISSABLE — 7 is the final mission itself. Make a manual save before the finale so you can replay it if the game offers mission replay.

stages.name: Collectibles and exploration
stages.order: Sweep Leonida district by district once the story stops pulling you around. Fold collectibles into every trip instead of saving them all for the end.
stages.warning: Biggest grind here: 100 WAiNK locations (31) and 52 areas of Leonida (42). Check the in-game collection and map screens to see what is left.

stages.name: Activities, money and cleanup
stages.order: Last: the activity grinds, the money trophies and the one-off world moments. Then the platinum pops on its own.
stages.warning: MISSABLE — 33 and 34 need your partner beside you, 37 is a one-off airport stunt, 39 fails if you are detected. Do those four while the story still pairs you up.

title: Roadmap to the platinum
